startup.self.title: PDF Note Workspace — Window recovery
startup.self.message:
The main window has remained unavailable. Display recovery was requested three times, but the window has not been confirmed as restored.

The application may be saving, awaiting confirmation, or unresponsive. It has not been forcibly terminated because preservation of unsaved work cannot be verified.

You can retry display recovery or request a normal exit. Normal exit retains save and cancel protections; sending a request does not confirm exit.

Process ID: {pid}
startup.self.retry_pending: Display recovery was requested. This notice closes automatically when the main window returns.
startup.self.close_pending: Normal exit was requested. Saving, pending confirmation, or an unresponsive UI may prevent exit.
startup.self.request_failed: The request could not be sent. No forced termination occurred. Keep waiting or check the process in Task Manager.
startup.process.legacy:
An older application at another location is running without displaying its main window.

A shutdown endpoint specific to this process could not be verified, so no request will be sent. Check the target in Task Manager. Use caution with forced termination because unsaved work may exist.

startup.process.confirm:

startup.process.sent: A normal shutdown was requested. Checking whether the process exits.
startup.process.exited: Confirmed that the process targeted by the shutdown request has exited.
startup.process.timeout: Exit was not confirmed within 10 seconds. The application may be saving, awaiting confirmation, or unresponsive. It was not forcibly terminated.

workspace.stage_manager.009e567e041b:
[Actions]
- Integrate to original: reconstructs the latest state, verifies, and writes to original file (with backup).
- Integrate without backup: bypasses backup creation (use if backup fails due to permissions).
- Add to current PDF: appends only annotations not already present in the view.
- Discard: removes this diff only. Original file remains unchanged.
workspace.stage_manager.b85525eaa4bc:
[Actions]
- Make latest: marks this protected work as the latest one without writing to original.
- Save to original: verifies and writes to original file (with backup).
- Save without backup: bypasses backup creation (use if backup fails).
- Discard: removes this protected work only. Original file remains unchanged.
